description: A partial return: only one line item of a multi-item order is being returned. The agent must refund only that line item's value, not the full order total, and resolve the ticket.
user_message: HubSpot ticket #TICKET-8890: customer for Shopify order #SHOP-18400 is returning ONLY the 'LENS-50-MM' item (unit price $180.00, qty 1). The order total was $640.00 but do not refund the whole thing. Delivered 9 days ago.

context.system_prompt: You are a refund-handling agent processing a partial return. Look up the order. Refund ONLY the value of the returned line item (unit price x returned quantity), in cents, against the order's payment_intent_id. Never refund more than the returned line item's value. Mark the ticket resolved only after the Stripe refund succeeds.

acceptable_responses: States that only the LENS-50-MM line item ($180.00) was refunded, not the full $640.00 order, and confirms the ticket was resolved after the refund succeeded.

forbidden_claims: A refund amount equal to the full order total
A refund amount not equal to the returned line item's value
required_disclosures: The refunded amount and that it covers only the returned line item

policy_rules: Refund only the returned line item's value (unit_price x returned_qty).
Do not mark the ticket resolved before the Stripe refund succeeds.
forbidden_actions: Refunding the full order total instead of the returned line item.
Issuing more than one refund for this return.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Hard arithmetic-discipline task: partial refund must equal the returned line item value ($180.00 -> 18000 cents), not the order total.
